column1: # ps components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
mode  user  -  your processes, busiest first                default
mode  all   -  all processes, busiest first                 -
mode  top   -  all processes, refreshed every few seconds   restart
mode  tree  -  process tree (input order: sorting off)      restart
toggle  kernel  alt-k  show kernel threads                      -
sort    cpu     -      user, all, top: busiest first                 default,desc
sort    mem     -      user, all, top: most memory first             desc
sort    age     -      user, all, top: newest first                  -
sort    pid     -      user, all, top: by pid                        -
action  term          ctrl-x  send SIGTERM to the selected processes (not yours: sudo -n)   notify,reload
action  kill          -       send SIGKILL to the selected processes (not yours: sudo -n)   silent,reload,confirm
action  sudo-term     -       send SIGTERM through sudo (asks for the password)              foreground,reload
action  sudo-kill     -       send SIGKILL through sudo (asks for the password)              foreground,reload,confirm
action  trace         alt-t   strace the process: every call (sudo; ctrl-c returns)          foreground
action  trace-errors  alt-T   strace the process: failing calls only (sudo; ctrl-c returns)  foreground
